"你已经开始锻骨了?什么时候的事?怎么一点都看不出来?"王壮疑问道。"哦!我也是刚开始没多久，就这两天的事。"江流怕刺激到王壮，没敢说实话。因为就是现在这样，王壮都已经没日没夜的修炼了，怕说实话了，王壮就会更加拼命的修炼。江流虽然不认为自己是一个好人，但是这里这么多的学徒里，也只有王壮是跟自己关系最好的了，江流是真心不希望王壮走进死胡同。"哦!看来，还是你进度快啊!我都已经拼命了，还是追不上你的进度。"王壮无奈的说道。看来人与人之间，真的是不能相比的。王壮有点释然地看着天空。"嗯!别想那么多。只要尽力了，顺其自然就好。修炼是要循序渐进的，不然一味地求快，损伤了根基，以后就难以寸进了!"江流转头对着王壮说道。"你倒是说得轻巧!每次考核都是你第一，肯定不担心了。我只是怕一年期满，达不到帮派的要求，不能留下，到时候回家就惨了。""我当时可是放下狠话，在这必会学有所成!不然就回去接受家里安排！家里才给我机会来这里的!"王壮无奈的说道。"好了!你是要回去？还是在这里修炼?我先回去了。"江流不想继续这个话题，起身说道。"你先回去吧!我在这里再修炼一会。"王壮看了江流一眼，也起身准备打坐恢复气血了。江流没再多说什么，扭头缓缓地走了。回到小院，江流盘坐在平日练功的石台上，运行五行拳气血搬运之法，恢复气血。五行拳是一整套包含打法，防御，气血运行和配套汤药的拳术秘籍!所以才会说这是最好的炼体功法!最主要的是齐全。落英帮也算是花大力气的培养这些帮派未来的骨干了。至于其他的帮派或者宗门有没有更好的秘籍功法？江流不知道，也没听说过。江流偶尔去药堂找海叔蹭汤药的时候，也听过海叔约略提到过，现在江湖上流传最多的是:三宗四派六世家，七教八谷十名流!这些大门大派，都存在着九品之上的宗师!虽然十大名流就十个人，但也全都是有大宗师的实力!九品之上为宗师境，宗师细分小宗师，大宗师，极境宗师三境!江流听得一脸向往，心想自己什么时候才能修炼到这个高度？海叔看着一脸向往神色的江流，没好气的一拍他头，"小子，别想那么远，你先入品再说吧!"江流想到这，顿时动力满满，我一定也能达到那等高度!"禀告林爷，终于找着那几个人的跟脚了!"林海紧步进入捕鹰趟驻地大厅，拱手向林爷说道。"哦？那么久终于露出马脚了，好家伙，真能忍啊!什么来路?"林爷问道。"应该就是散鹰堂派来的。""还真是这该死的郑狼啊!我之前就估计是他的人。""因为之前总堂主分给我们福荣街的时候，就他反应最是强烈!""怎么?福荣街是我们兄弟打下来的!他凭什么反对?""他郑狼认为，他散鹰堂也出力了，应该分给他一半!""他散鹰堂哪里出力了?他自己想占三马街没占下来!就想来我们这里捞好处?""他郑狼可不这样认为!他认为如果没有他的散鹰堂，出了大力去牵制住瀚海帮，不然我们可没那么容易占下福荣街!""现在他们人出了，钱出了，打三马街的时候，人也死了不少，结果什么都没捞到!肯定心里不忿!看不得我们好了!""福荣街，我们可是按照总堂主的承诺，谁打下来就归谁的!他郑狼凭什么眼红?""郑狼现在这样派人来捣乱，我们要不要上报总堂?""不用!就这点小事就要上报总堂!那不是显得我林豪很没用?一点小事就要上报?""你先去把那几个散鹰堂的人控制好。别让郑狼找到，我以后有用。至于闹事的那些，你现在可以收网了，一个都别让他们跑了。"林爷吩咐道。"是!"林海躬身应道，转身出了大厅。

Chapter 21 Three sects, four sects, six aristocratic families, seven religions, eight grains and ten names (page 1)
"You have started to forge your bones? When did you do it? Why can't you see it at all?" Wang Zhuang asked. "Oh! I just started, just these two days." Jiang Liu didn't dare to tell the truth for fear of irritating Wang Zhuang. Because even now, Wang Zhuang has been practicing day and night. He is afraid that if he tells the truth, Wang Zhuang will practice even harder. Although Jiang Liu doesn't think he is a good person, among the many apprentices here, only Wang Zhuang has the best relationship with him. Jiang Liu really doesn't want Wang Zhuang to go into a dead end. "Oh! It seems that you are progressing faster! I have tried my best, but I still can't catch up with your progress." Wang Zhuang said helplessly. It seems that there is really no comparison between people. Wang Zhuang looked at the sky with some relief. "Well! Don't think so much. Just do your best and let nature take its course. Cultivation must be done step by step. Otherwise, if you blindly pursue speed and damage your foundation, you will have difficulty making progress in the future!" Jiang Liu turned to Wang Zhuang and said. "You put it lightly! You ranked first in every assessment, so I don't have to worry anymore. I'm just afraid that I won't be able to stay if I fail to meet the gang's requirements after one year. Then I will be miserable when I go home." "I put aside my harsh words at that time. I will definitely succeed in my studies here! Otherwise, I will go back and accept the arrangements from my family! My family gave me the opportunity to come here!" Wang Zhuang said helplessly. "Okay! Do you want to go back? Or practice here? I'm going back first." Jiang Liu stood up and said not wanting to continue this topic. "You go back first! I'll practice here for a while." Wang Zhuang glanced at Jiang Liu and stood up to meditate to restore his energy and blood. Jiang Liu didn't say anything more, turned around and walked away slowly. Back in the small courtyard, Jiang Liu sat cross-legged on the stone platform where he usually practiced, performing the Five Elements Boxing Qi and Blood Transfer method to restore Qi and blood. Five Elements Boxing is a set of boxing secrets that include fighting techniques, defense, Qi and blood circulation and supporting decoctions! That’s why it is said to be the best body training method! The most important thing is that it is complete. The Luoying Gang can be regarded as putting great effort into cultivating the future backbone of these gangs. As for other gangs or sects, do they have better secret techniques? Jiang Liu didn't know or heard of it. When Jiang Liu occasionally went to the medicine hall to ask Uncle Hai for some decoction, he also heard Uncle Hai briefly mention that the most popular rumors in the world now are: three sects, four sects, six aristocratic families, seven sects, eight valleys, and ten celebrities! These big sects all have masters above the ninth grade! Although There are only ten of the top ten celebrities, but they all have the strength of a Grand Master! Above the ninth level is the Grand Master realm, and the Grand Master is divided into three realms: Little Grandmaster, Grand Master, and Extreme Grand Master! Jiang Liu heard this with a look of yearning on his face, wondering when he would be able to reach this level of cultivation? Uncle Hai looked at Jiang Liu with a yearning look on his face and patted him on the head angrily, "Boy, don't think so far ahead. You can finish it first and then talk about it!" Thinking of this, Jiang Liu was immediately full of motivation. I will definitely be able to reach that level! "Tell Mr. Lin, I finally found those few people!" Lin Hai quickly entered the hall of the Eagle Catching Station and said to Mr. Lin with his hands raised. "Oh? It's been so long that the truth has finally been revealed. Good guy, you can really bear it! What's the reason?" Mr. Lin asked. "It should be sent by San Ying Tang." "Really this damn Zheng Lang! I thought he was his before." "Because when the chief hall master gave us Furong Street, he had the strongest reaction!" "What? Our brothers defeated Furong Street! Why should he object?" "Zheng Lang thinks that San Ying Tang has also contributed, so he should be given half!" "Where did San Ying Tang contribute? HeHe wanted to occupy Sanma Street, but he didn't! He just wanted to come to us to get benefits?" "Zheng Lang doesn't think so! He thinks that if it weren't for his Sanyingtang and the great efforts to contain the Hanhai Gang, otherwise we wouldn't be able to occupy Furong Street so easily!" "Now they have people and money, and many people died when they attacked Sanma Street, but they didn't get anything! They must be angry! Can't see it. It's up to us!" "Fu Rong Street, we follow the promise of the chief hall master, whoever kills it will get it! Why is Zheng Lang jealous?" "Zheng Lang is sending people to cause trouble like this. Do we want to report it to the main hall?" "No! We have to report this little thing to the main hall! Doesn't that make me, Lin Hao, useless? I have to report every little thing?" "You go and control those people from the Sanying Hall first. Don't let Zheng Lang find it, I will be useful in the future. As for those causing trouble, you can close the net now and don’t let any of them escape. "Master Lin ordered. "Yes!" Lin Hai bowed in response, turned around and left the hall.
